description: This file defines the PredicateParser interface, which specifies the contract for parser classes that parse predicate expressions into an abstract syntax tree (AST) represented by RootNode.

classes.name: PredicateParser
classes.description: Interface that defines a parser for predicate expressions, converting a string input into an AST rooted at RootNode.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the given input string to produce an AST represented by RootNode. Throws NullPointerException if input is null.
